title: 22 July 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
content:
The Beatles’ 84th evening show at the Cavern Club took place on this date.

Overall this was their 201st appearance at the underground Mathew Street venue, including the lunchtime shows.

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

  • 1987: Mixing: Choba B CCCP by Paul McCartney
  • 1972: Wings live: Pavillon, Montreux
  • 1971: John Lennon and Yoko Ono give multiple interviews
  • 1971: Paul McCartney jams with Denny Laine and Denny Seiwell
  • 1971: Northern Songs sues Maclen Music, Inc
  • 1969: Recording: Oh! Darling, Come Together
  • 1968: Recording: A Beginning, Good Night
  • 1967: John Lennon and Paul McCartney travel to Greece
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Odeon Cinema, Weston-super-Mare
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Holyoake Hall, Liverpool
